content: Triggerings on PhysicalChannel The following modeling creates a "membership" of ISignal s, ISignalGroup s, Pdu s, and Frame s in a given PhysicalChannel : • PhysicalChannel aggregates  ISignalTriggering that in turn references ISignal in the role iSignal  ISignalTriggering that in turn references an ISignalGroup in the role iSignalGroup ([TPS_SYST_02105] applies). • PhysicalChannel aggregates PduTriggering that in turn references a Pdu in the role iPdu . • PhysicalChannel aggregates FrameTriggering that in turn references a Frame in the role frame .
